title: Can your phone really blast a petrol pump?
caption:
"Phone off bro, it'll blast!" ⛽📵
Twist: experts have never documented a single petrol pump fire caused by a phone.
The real danger is static electricity. Petrol gives off vapour, and one tiny spark from your body can light it — most of these fires happened when people got back into the car mid-fill, then touched the nozzle.
Still follow the rules at the pump, and never smoke there.
Send this to the friend who always says it'll blast 😅
